scenarios.automatic_boundary: BucketName-APPID is absent and dedicated, exact account/region identity is observed, and public access is a creation-time choice on that new bucket.
Prefix is non-empty, exclusive, empty, non-overlapping, and the policy change is limited to anonymous GetObject for that prefix.
Only a newly created dedicated bucket is eligible because COS CORS is bucket-scoped.
blocked_when: unrelated rule cannot be preserved exactly

merge_rules.lifecycle: Read all rules, retain unrelated rows in order, reject any prefix overlap, and append or exactly match one deterministic managed id.
merge_rules.cors: Read the complete ruleset, retain unrelated rows in order, reject origin/method overlap, and append or exactly match one deterministic managed id.

no_credentials_available: No COS Key or authenticated browser session was available. Every real state, permission, UI marker, success observation, and recovery boundary is not-tested.
enablement: Requires a separate human-gated COS console recording, data matrix, reviewed setup evidence, and an enabling ADR.
